title: Code2Form circuit (.c2fc)
description: The parts of an electronics build, where each one sits, and the wires between their pins. Written in TOML; wires are laid in the order the file lists them.

enclosure.description: The .c2f file of the enclosure, next to the circuit or in the library folders.

parts.description: The parts, by the name wires call them by.

wires.description: The wires, in the order they are laid.

literal.description: A value as a .scad constant: a boolean, a number, a string, or an array of them.

part.description: The part's .c2f file, which declares its pins in // @pin comments; next to the circuit or in the library folders.

at.description: Where the part's origin goes, in millimeters, as translate([x, y, z]). [0, 0, 0] by default.

rotate.description: Degrees about x, then y, then z, as rotate([x, y, z]), before moving it. [0, 0, 0] by default.

params.description: Values for the part's variables, as c2f -D name=value sets them.

color.description: A color to show the part in.

label.description: What the wire carries, as shown next to it.
